study_identification_part.si_4_title: Individualized resting-state functional connectivity abnormalities unveil two major depressive disorder subtypes with contrasting abnormal patterns of abnormality

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: REST-meta-MDD consortium data (25 research sites) was the primary dataset for MDD analysis; COBRE (Center for Biomedical Research Excellence) was used for disease specificity analysis comparing schizophrenia patients
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The imaging datasets for MDD used in this study were sourced from the REST-meta-MDD consortium (http://rfmri.org/RESTmeta-MDD)" ... "Finally, to examined whether extreme functional connectivity profile we reported is specific to MDD, we applied the same analysis pipeline to a dataset of schizophrenia patients from Centre for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE, http://fcon_1000.-projects.nitrc.org/indi/retro/cobre.html)"
